== Ingredients ==

=== Crust ===
* 2 packages [[Cookbook:Graham Cracker|graham crackers]], crushed to fine crumbs
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ¾ cup melted [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]

=== Cheesecake mixture ===
* 1 large package of [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
* 1½ cup [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
* 2 packages [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]] or [[Cookbook:Imitation Whipped Topping|Dream Whip (frozen non-dairy topping)]]
* 1 can cherry pie filling

== Procedure ==
# Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted margarine. Press this mixture into a large [[Cookbook:Pyrex|pyrex]] [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie dish]] to make a crust.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] crust for 8 minutes at 325°F (160°C). Let cool completely.
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] cream cheese and powdered sugar together.
# Prepare the whipped topping according to directions (if necessary).
# [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] the whipped topping into the cream cheese mixture. Place this mixture into the cooled crust, and smooth the top.
# Top with cherry pie filling.
